shared_contexts.method: Four decoder contexts share one VA display, with round-robin packet submission in one thread; shorter contexts close while longer streams continue. Each stream must match independent software decoding. Repeat with normal and early export.
shared_contexts.limit: Interleaved single-thread behavior, not concurrent API calls or throughput.

hardware_guard.policy: Read-only idle preflight; finite child deadlines; poll stuck tasks, unrelated browser/player decoder clients and new AVD journal errors every 0.5 seconds. Check final kernel journal window as well.

from pathlib import Path
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time
from avdlab.guard import preflight, run, ResultLog, wedge_monitor, decoder_state
out=Path('results/codec-r11-package');out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
log=ResultLog(out/'guard.jsonl')
repo='/home/chrisk/src/publish/libva-v4l2_request'
driver='/home/chrisk/src/avd-lab/results/builds/codec-r11-package/pkg/libva-v4l2_request-avd/usr/lib/dri'
since=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
def monitor():
    clients=[h for h in decoder_state().holders if any(s in h['cmd'] for s in ('chrome','firefox','mpv'))]
    if clients:return 'unrelated decoder client: '+str(clients)
    reason=wedge_monitor()
    if reason:return reason
    r=subprocess.run(['journalctl','-k','--since',since,'--no-pager','-o','cat'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
    if r.returncode:return 'kernel journal read failed'
    errors=[s for s in r.stdout.splitlines() if 'avd' in s.lower() and any(w in s.lower() for w in ('error','timeout','failed','timed out'))]
    return 'new decoder error: '+errors[0] if errors else None
try:
    for name,suite,extra in [
      ('hevc','h.265/JCT-VC-HEVC_V1',[]),
      ('avc','h.264/JVT-AVC_V1',[]),
      ('frext','h.264/JVT-FR-EXT',[]),
      ('vp9','vp9/VP9-TEST-VECTORS',[]),
      ('vp9-high10','vp9/VP9-TEST-VECTORS-HIGH',['--vectors','vp92-2-20-10bit-yuv420.webm']),
      ('overrides','h.264/JVT-AVC_V1',['--profile-mismatch','--vectors','BA3_SVA_C','MR2_TANDBERG_E','MR3_TANDBERG_B','MR4_TANDBERG_C','MR5_TANDBERG_C'])]:
        st=preflight()
        env=os.environ.copy()
        if name=='frext':env['LIBVA_V4L2_H264_HIGH10']='ffmpeg'
        cmd=['python3',repo+'/tests/conformance.py','/home/chrisk/src/fluster/test_suites/'+suite+'.json','/home/chrisk/src/fluster/resources','--driver',driver,'--output',str(out/name),*extra]
        log.write(event='start',name=name,state=st,cmd=cmd,high10=env.get('LIBVA_V4L2_H264_HIGH10','off'))
        r=run(cmd,deadline=300,env=env,log_dir=out,name=name,abort_if=monitor,poll=0.5)
        log.write(event='result',name=name,result=r,state=decoder_state())
        print(name,r.returncode,r.stdout.splitlines()[-2:],flush=True)
        if r.timed_out or r.wedged or r.abort_reason or r.returncode not in (0,1) or monitor():sys.exit(2)
    for name,script in [('h264-high10','h264-high10.sh'),('vp9-matrix','vp9-matrix.sh')]:
        st=preflight()
        cmd=['sh',repo+'/tests/'+script,driver]
        log.write(event='start',name=name,state=st,cmd=cmd)
        r=run(cmd,deadline=240,log_dir=out,name=name,abort_if=monitor,poll=0.5)
        log.write(event='result',name=name,result=r,state=decoder_state())
        print(name,r.returncode,r.stdout,flush=True)
        if r.timed_out or r.wedged or r.abort_reason or r.returncode or monitor():sys.exit(2)

finally:
    (out/'kernel.log').write_text(subprocess.run(['journalctl','-k','--since',since,'--no-pager','-o','short-precise'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30).stdout)
